verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime publishes an API reference with per-endpoint pages that appear to be generated from an OpenAPI spec (e.g. 'summary: Create a Webhook'). It also offers a free Developer Sandbox and a first-party Postman Collection 'to speed up your initial exploration of our APIs', which together provide runnable examples. However, no evidence shows that the reference itself is interactive (e.g. an in-page 'try it' console), and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at standard paths. missing for 10: documented in-browser interactive 'try it' console in the reference, runnable code samples embedded in reference pages, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
